thread:
maria_g: quick sync  fastlane copy + routing handoff. objective: 1 tight hero + 1 supporting line per mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), three launch posts, bench stat soundbite, and webinar hook. 20m.

noah_growth: high-level plan: teaser -> benchmark -> webinar. metric to test: 'cost-per-request' vs 'p95 latency' tradeoff. want one concise bench soundbite for social and one longer paragraph for the blog.

anya_prod: hero candidates (short): Hosted: "Spin up models in minutes, pay by usage"; Dedicated: "Reserved capacity for mission-critical throughput"; Private: "On-prem & VPC deployments for regulated data". supporting line: 12-15 words calling out performance + predictable economics.

leo_design: CTA verbs: Hosted = Try Free, Dedicated = Reserve Capacity, Private = Request Review. Private needs a sticky micro-cta above the fold: "Request private review" opens prefilled modal for logged-in users. also recommend a tiny trust-strip: SLA • KMS • Audit logs.

cs_bot: CS nugget (anonymized): "An enterprise customer reduced tail latency by ~35% after switching to Dedicated during peak traffic". filing for opt-in to use their name.

eng_webhooks: routing payload we'll implement for the form. devs: please wire this webhook and add basic lead scoring rules. sample payload: 

```
POST /hooks/lead-capture
{
  "email": "...",
  "mode_interest": "hosted|dedicated|private",
  "company_size": "...",
  "compliance_needs": "none|privacy-sensitive|regulated",
  "est_annual_spend": "<50k|50-200k|>200k"
}
```

routing rules (proto): if est_annual_spend == ">200k" OR company_size >= 500 OR compliance_needs == "regulated" -> route to AE queue + high lead score; else -> nurture flow (SDR). Tag HubSpot with mode_interest, est_annual_spend, compliance_needs. Return 200 on success and retry on 5xx.

legal_j: lightweight legal note: avoid absolutes in public copy. use qualifiers: "in internal benchmarks" and add footnote with methodology. for customer quotes we need written opt-in before naming.

noah_growth: bench soundbite draft: "In internal tests, Redwood reduced serving spend up to 3x on representative workloads while keeping p95 latency within target ranges.*" footnote -> blog with methodology. we'll A/B that vs a trust-first line: "SLA-backed inference for production ML."

leo_design: creative needs: hero GIF (3 states), benchmark chart PNG, 30s promo. also a short animated CTA for Private modal.

webinar-bot: Event created: "Fastlane Serving: Cost vs Latency in Production" on 2026-05-07 10:00 PT. Registration: https://events.redwood.ai/fastlane-serve. Reminder: add partner co-host by EOD Friday for cross-promo.

maria_g: timeline: copy freeze Tue 5pm PT, creative freeze Wed noon, announce next Mon. A/B plan: Variant A = metric-first hero; Variant B = trust-first hero. run paid tests focused on demo CTR and demo vs signup conversion. devs: add lead scoring weight for est_annual_spend and compliance flags (assign 30 and 40 pts respectively). I'll drop Asana tasks and the doc with final copy options shortly. Thanks team :rocket:
